body:
Adds `research/straggler-backup` (stdlib Python, MIT): exact order-statistic round times for backup workers (exponential and Pareto, Pareto mean finite iff n-k+1 > 1/alpha), exact SGD time-to-accuracy with a minimum k and interior optimum, joint step tuning, and the exact selection bias of the speed filter with Horvitz-Thompson correction. Includes 10 tests, experiment log, white paper, README and portfolio entries.
